SAME original dense closable compact-smooth gradient D_y chosen BEFORE ALL meanzero L2 forcing f and epsilon sequences.

Construct true common Gaussian/disintegrating/reflected J/R/S and one original dense closable D_y before ALL centered forcing/epsilon sequences. Construct true same-domain variational solutions on actual S_y with strong epsilon_n*u_n zero limit, retaining source curvature/eta cap/partition/order.

True C1 Gibbs W/positive exponential normalizer/actual normalized probability and SAME exact original compact-smooth closable gradient beforeALLf; genuine mean-zero L2 forcing is integrable and kernel-orthogonal via actual AEconstant. Construct actual positive-epsilon variational solutions, retaining ordinary localL1/weakC1 test integrabilities. Actual common PBPS J/R/S/reflected law/sourceC2 alpha-beta/eta cap/positive partitions and originalD_y beforeALLf/epsilon; fiberwise only. blind_reconstruction.text:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with NormedAddCommGroup, InnerProductSpace R, FiniteDimensional R, MeasurableSpace and BorelSpace instances and canonical volume, including dimension zero. Let V:E->R, alpha,beta:NNReal,eta:R. Assume alpha cast>0,alpha<=beta,V C2 and for every x,a:E BOTH
  alpha*||a||^2 <= (fderiv R (fderiv R V) x a) a,
  (fderiv R (fderiv R V) x a) a <= beta*||a||^2.
Assume eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. Define actual measures/potential
  mu=volume.tilted(x->-V(x)),
  J=map((x,g)->(x,x+sqrt(eta)*g),mu.prod(stdGaussian E)),
  W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+||z-y||^2/(8*eta).
These are genuine normalized Gibbs tilt,independent product with standard real Hilbert Gaussian and pushforward.
There exist common kernels R,S:E->Measure E with R,S Markov,R a true conditional kernel for J.map Prod.swap,and for every y S(y)=(R(y)).map(x->2*x-y).
For EVERY y, S(y)=volume.tilted(z->-W_y(z)),W_y C2,exp(-W_y) volume-integrable with strictly positive volume integral. There exists ONE original real-linear partial gradient D:Lp R 2 (S(y))->partialLinear[R] Lp E 2 (S(y)) with dense domain in scalar L2,closability,closed closure,and exact graph: for every scalar a/vector G,(a,G) is in D.graph iff exists smooth compactly supported real phi with a=phi S(y)-AE and G=gradient(phi) S(y)-AE.
For EVERY actual scalar L2(S(y)) forcing f with integral f(x) dS(y)(x)=0,and EVERY epsilon:N->R positive at every n and tending atTop0,there exists ONE family u:N->this SAME D.closure.domain such that for EVERY n and EVERY v:D.closure.domain,
  epsilon_n*<u_n,v>_{L2(S(y);R)}+<D.closure(u_n),D.closure(v)>_{L2(S(y);E)}=<f,v>_{L2(S(y);R)},
and epsilon_n scalar-multiplied by the actual scalar L2(S(y)) class u_n tends atTop strongly to the zero quotient.
One common R,S precedes all y,one original D per y precedes ALL centered f and ALL positive-to-zero sequences,one family follows f/epsilon before every n and variational test. All y have density/operator facts;conditional disintegration has usual version scope,not a claim about all possible versions on every y. Only the literal reflected normalized-law equality is asserted,no equality of two distinct conditional kernels.
The displayed sequence output is exactly a variational family and scaled-function strong-zero. It does not separately list forcing Integrable,ordinary local weak/PDE/cutoff facts or scaled-gradient convergence as output conjuncts. Forcing is actual weighted L2 with actual law mean0;no abstract orthogonality premise or centered-u assumption replaces it. Partition integrability uses volume;means,inner products and limit use S(y). No monotonicity,rate,uniform unscaled bound,joint measurable y/f/sequence selection,unscaled/range/epsilon0/further functional inequality,score variance,full adjoint/core/Hessian or main/expected-cost composition conclusion is asserted.

theorem conditional_centered_resolvent_sequence
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : NNReal} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α:ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x a : E, (α:ℝ)*‖a‖^2 ≤ fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x a a ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x a a ≤ (β:ℝ)*‖a‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β:ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2)) (μ.prod (stdGaussian E))
    let W := fun y u : E => V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+u))+‖u-y‖^2/(8*η)
    ∃ R S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel R ∧ IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (J.map Prod.swap).IsCondKernel R ∧
      (∀ y, S y=(R y).map (fun x => (2:ℝ) • x-y)) ∧
      ∀ y, S y=(volume : Measure E).tilted (fun u => -W y u) ∧
        ContDiff ℝ 2 (W y) ∧ Integrable (fun u => Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        0 < ∫ u, Real.exp (-W y u) ∧
        ∃ D : Lp ℝ 2 (S y) →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 (S y),
          Dense (D.domain : Set (Lp ℝ 2 (S y))) ∧ D.IsClosable ∧ D.closure.IsClosed ∧
          (∀ (a : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) (G : Lp E 2 (S y)), (a,G) ∈ D.graph ↔
            ∃ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧
              a =ᵐ[S y] φ ∧ G =ᵐ[S y] gradient φ) ∧
          ∀ f : Lp ℝ 2 (S y), (∫ x, f x ∂S y)=0 →
          ∀ (ε : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ n, 0 < ε n) → Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) →
          ∃ u : ℕ → D.closure.domain,
            (∀ n, ∀ v : D.closure.domain,
              ε n*inner ℝ (u n : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))+
                inner ℝ (D.closure (u n)) (D.closure v)=inner ℝ f (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))) ∧
            Tendsto (fun n => ε n • (u n : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  obtain ⟨R,S,hR,hS,hcond,hSR,hfiber⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ConditionalScoreClosedDomain.conditional_score_closed_gradient_domain
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨R,S,hR,hS,hcond,hSR,?_⟩
  intro y
  obtain ⟨hSy,hW,hI,hZ,D,hd,hD,hDc,hgraph,_⟩ := hfiber y
  refine ⟨hSy,hW,hI,hZ,D,hd,hD,hDc,hgraph,?_⟩

  rw [← hSy] at hg
  intro f hf ε hε hε0
  obtain ⟨_,u,hu,ht⟩ := hg D hD hgraph f hf ε hε hε0
  exact ⟨u,fun n => (hu n).1,ht⟩
